bootstrap.pairing: identical draws for sorted query IDs on identical support

technical_tests.selection: WANDS development targets by SHA256(recent-model-tech|product_id); shortest/longest within first 32; query first 3 by ID hash
technical_tests.reference: official SentenceTransformer.encode; shared frozen backbone, independently implemented pooling
technical_tests.tolerance_basis: BF16 native reference component rounding; strict ID equality and output comparison; NOT ranking epsilon

boundary_audit.selection: all crossing witnesses with abs(margin) <= measured technical repeat score range, all exact ties, plus first 8 crossing pairs by salted ID hash per dataset/intervention/K
boundary_audit.profile: rerun original batches containing selected queries, targets, and Kth competitors with all original batch companions; score the full catalog using the identical FP32 matrix shape and frozen profile; other vectors retain their compatible original profile
boundary_audit.label: numerical_ambiguity if any cutoff decision differs; no epsilon-based rank correction

model.name: google/embeddinggemma-2
model.pooling: attention-mask mean including prompt after native projection

model.scoring: numpy FP32 matmul; 4 BLAS threads; full query matrix per schedule
